summary: Frontend-only testing of the new conditional 'Tipologia Abitazione' field for servizio PRESIDI in Clienti (Create/Edit/View). Full cascade (F2F -> Fastweb -> PRESIDI -> ENERGIA FASTWEB -> Privato -> ENT4) reached correctly. All three modal states behave as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: CreateClienteModal + EditClienteModal use browser-native HTML5 required attribute on the tipologia_abitazione <select>. Because the select has required + the empty value option, the browser's native 'Please select an item in the list' tooltip fires BEFORE the JS toast validation ('Per il servizio Presidi, la Tipologia Abitazione è obbligatoria...') gets a chance to run. Functionally the field is still mandatory and cannot be submitted empty, but the specific destructive toast wording will only appear if the form is submitted via a code path that bypasses the browser's native validation (e.g., novalidate on the form, or programmatic submit). Consider adding `noValidate` on the <form> element (or removing `required` from the select) if the exact toast text is required by acceptance criteria. Otherwise, the native validation is arguably better UX.

Cognome/Nome inputs rely on `input#cognome`/`input#nome` ids but lack dedicated data-testid attributes. Non-blocking, but adding e.g. `create-cliente-cognome-input` would improve automation reliability.

The Edit modal save button label is 'Aggiorna Cliente' (assumed) but it collided in name matching with the Clienti list top 'Aggiorna ora' auto-refresh button — recommend adding data-testid like `edit-cliente-submit-btn` and `create-cliente-submit-btn` to disambiguate.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created client TESTPRES1785510157 (id d52c49d4-...) via POST /api/clienti with tipologia_abitazione=Villa/Villetta for edit/view testing; deleted after test (DELETE 200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PRESIDI servizio ids: 449e5924-... (Fastweb), 72d1a8da-... (Telepass), 2119d1ab-... (HO Mobile). F2F sub-agenzia id 7c70d4b5-... allows reaching PRESIDI via Fastweb commessa (4cb70f28-...). Cascade steps: sub -> commessa -> servizio -> tipologia -> segmento -> offerta; native <select> elements (indexes 0-5) inside modal. Once offerta is chosen the form transitions automatically to 'Compila Scheda Cliente' (no explicit Continua click needed). Tipologia Abitazione select has data-testid `create-cliente-tipologia-abitazione-select` (create), `edit-cliente-tipologia-abitazione-select` (edit), and read-only `view-cliente-tipologia-abitazione` (view).

rca of the issue: Not applicable - no bugs found. Only a UX nuance regarding native vs. JS validation ordering documented under critical_code_review_comments.
